title: Notice: Annual Examination Schedule
summary: Bilingual (Hindi and English) notice MPS/ADM/2024/112 from Model Public School, Jaipur, dated 02/01/2024, announcing that annual examinations begin on 15/03/2024. The examination fee must be deposited by 20/02/2024 and admit cards are available from 05/03/2024. Signed by the Principal, Dr. S. Iyer.
